compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Quoting the office visit benefit without the $2,000 combined cap, or quoting one waiting period and letting the client assume it applies to everything.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe office visits and urgent care as separately limited - the cap is shared. Do not state a single waiting period for the plan.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Office and urgent care visits share a combined $2,000 limit for the coverage period, and that includes anything else done during those visits. On waiting periods: 5 days for illness, 30 days for cancer, and none at all for injuries.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Office and urgent care visits share a COMBINED maximum benefit of $2,000 per coverage period, including additional services rendered during those visits. Waiting periods are 5 days for sickness, 30 days for cancer, and none for injuries.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Always. The page itself instructs the agent to verify the elected policy maximum on every sale.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: The monthly cost quoted on a recorded call must include this fee, or the fee must be stated separately before the payment authorisation. Quoting the product page price alone understates what the client will be charged.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A 3.5% credit-card or ACH processing fee applies to every payment and appears only in the platform TERMS panel, which more than half the product pages do not display at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client a scheduled benefit amount will be paid in full without qualifying it by the URC limit.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A platform-level usual, reasonable and customary cap applies on top of every product's stated benefits and appears only in the TERMS panel.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every recorded verification must cover all four elements. Omitting the recurring monthly amount or the automatic draft is a breach of the platform agreement, not only a compliance risk.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The platform agreement requires an electronic signature or a recorded verification script with every sale, and specifies the four things the member must be shown to understand: the product, its benefits, the initial payment, and the recurring monthly amount drafted automatically.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose to any client on a tight account that a single failed draft can end the plan.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A dishonoured payment can result in forfeiture of the plan with no liability on anyone's part, expressly including where the dishonour was inadvertent or without cause.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe NEO as the insurance company. Name the carrier for the specific product.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neo Insurance Solutions is an agency and platform, not the insurer, and disclaims liability for agents' conduct and representations.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose the 3.5% card/ACH processing fee on every sale regardless of which page the client was shown. Do not rely on the panel a given product page happens to display.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The storefront serves two different versions of the NEO enrolment agreement. The shorter one, on the MDLive pages, omits the 3.5% processing fee, the contact and electronic-document consents, the HIPAA statement and the member signature block.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client 'the terms are on the page'. Establish which agreement governs their enrolment, and disclose the 3.5% processing fee regardless of which panel their product displays.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Four different NEO enrolment agreements are in simultaneous circulation on the storefront, and most product pages show none at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Treat every figure in it as requiring confirmation against a current certificate before it is quoted on a recorded call.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The only document source for two products live for sale today is a brochure copyrighted February 2020 whose internal PDF title is a December 2018 PowerPoint export.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Three years is longer than most clients expect. Disclose the length AND the manifestation prong: a condition never diagnosed can still be pre-existing.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The pre-existing condition definition reaches back 36 months on two prongs - treatment received, and symptoms that would have caused an ordinarily prudent person to seek treatment. The second prong catches undiagnosed conditions.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never present the rider as covering pre-existing conditions. It only carries forward coverage a member already earned in a previous term.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The Pre-Existing Waiver Rider waives conditions that were covered during a PRIOR coverage period. It does not remove the 36-month lookback for a new applicant.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: A client buying 36 months pays the deductible three times. State this before close.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: On a 36-month consecutive-term sale the deductible, coinsurance and all benefit limits reset with each 12 month block.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe the Limited plan as paying 80% after the deductible. On most benefits it pays a fixed dollar amount and the client owes the rest. Name the cap for the benefit being discussed.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: On the Limited plan almost every major benefit is capped in dollars: $1,500 a day room rate, $2,000 a day ICU, $5,000 per surgery, $1,500 outpatient surgery per day, $250 per ER visit, $2,000 a year for office and urgent care visits combined, $50,000 for transplants. The Traditional plan runs these through the deductible and coinsurance instead.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Explain balance-billing exposure: a facility billing above 150% of Medicare can pursue the member for the difference.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Facility charges are paid up to 150% of Medicare allowable charges, not up to billed charges or a network discount.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose the auto-continuation and that the rate can change between terms.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: On a consecutive-term enrolment, subsequent terms begin automatically and the member is emailed a new monthly rate with an opportunity to opt out.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Present both as services attached to the policy, never as benefits of it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: RightWay patient advocacy is expressly not insurance and provides no coverage. PHCS is a discount network that does not process claims and is not affiliated with either underwriter.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Ten of the eleven linked brochures are READ and fully extracted into the ledger, but the PDF files themselves are not in Drive. The documents behind 25 live variants therefore exist in this project only as extracted facts, not as retrievable source documents.

association.v: NCE - the National Congress of Employers

carrier.v: American Financial Security Life Insurance Company (AFSLIC) and Standard Life And Casualty Insurance Company

network.v: PHCS Network (Private Healthcare Systems). Insureds may be treated in or out of network. Approximately 900,000 contracted providers

lookback_months.v: 36 months immediately preceding the Covered Person's Effective Date, on both the treatment prong and the manifestation prong

pre_existing.v: An optional Pre-Existing Waiver Rider is available where offered. The page states that if selected the rider can waive certain waiting periods in subsequent terms and helps avoid re-qualifying for another term when conditions were covered during the prior coverage period.

waiting_period_other.v: 5 days for sickness, 30 days for cancer; no waiting period for injuries

open_gaps.what_is_unknown: Every product Info page and Cost page on both platforms; roughly 110 pages in total.

benefit.home_health_care.v: Up to $30 per day and a maximum of 30 days per Coverage Period

benefit.hospital_intensive_or_critical_c.v: Up to $2,000 per day including all Inpatient miscellaneous medical expenses except for professional fees

benefit.in_hospital_physician_visits.v: Up to $50 per day up to a maximum $500 per Coverage Period

consecutive_terms.v: On a consecutive-term enrolment the customer is issued their initial term with subsequent terms pending; the waiting period on all subsequent terms is waived; no reapplication is needed; before each subsequent term the customer receives an email with their new monthly rate and an opportunity to opt out
